newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade inactive - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 14 (Reuder) - Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.

Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 3,800 cattle, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. Asking prices $64.00-$66.00 per cwt, mostly $64.00-$65.00, bids $62.00. Last sales at $62.00 Friday. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - none
